paragraphs.text: Legions has two monocolored and two bicolored theme decks .
Elvish Rage is a green theme deck with a Elf tribal theme.
The rares in this deck are Elvish Soultiller and Tribal Forcemage .

The Elvish Rage decklist states that the deck contains a Taunting Elf ; however, the physical deck itself contains a Snarling Undorak in its place. Customers may contact Wizards Customer Service for that Taunting Elf if necessary.
Morph Mayhem is a white / blue theme deck with a morph theme.
The rares in this deck are Chromeshell Crab and Weaver of Lies .
Sliver Shivers is a green /white/blue theme deck with a Sliver tribal theme.
The rares in this deck are Brood Sliver and Essence Sliver .
Zombies Unleashed is a black theme deck with a Zombie tribal theme.
The rares in this deck are Ghastly Remains and Graveborn Muse .
